cards.ex: When you meet the director, remember to mind your P's and Q's.
cards.exUz: Direktor bilan uchrashganda, odobli bo'lishni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni xushmuomala va hurmatli tutish, ayniqsa rasmiy vaziyatda.

cards.ex: I take exception to your implication that I'm not working hard enough.
cards.exUz: Sizning men yetarlicha ishlamayapman degan ishorangizga noroziman.
cards.uzDef: Nimaga qarshi chiqish, rozi bo'lmaslik, tanqid qilish.

cards.ex: With all due respect, I think you're mistaken about the facts.
cards.exUz: Hurmat bilan aytmoqchimanki, siz faktlar bo'yicha adashyapsiz.
cards.uzDef: Hurmatni saqlagan holda fikrga qarshi chiqish.

cards.ex: Let's cut to the chase – can we get this deal done today?
cards.exUz: Keling, asosiy mavzuga o'taylik - bu bitimni bugun yakunlay olamizmi?
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz tafsilotlarsiz, darhol muhim nuqtaga o'tish.

cards.ex: This hotel is a far cry from the luxury resort I expected.
cards.exUz: Bu mehmonxona men kutgan hashamatli kurortdan mutlaqo boshqa.
cards.uzDef: Ikki narsa o'rtasida katta farq borligini ko'rsatadi.

cards.ex: We've worked together for years; we're on a first-name basis.
cards.exUz: Biz yillar davomida birga ishladik; biz ismlashib gaplashamiz.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan shunchalik yaqinki, ismi bilan murojaat qilish.

cards.ex: He extended his hand and said, "How do you do? I'm Mr. Smith."
cards.exUz: U qo'lini uzatdi va dedi: "Qandaysiz? Men janob Smitman."
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy salomlashish, 'Assalomu alaykum'ga o'xshash.

cards.ex: I hate making small talk at networking events.
cards.exUz: Tarmoq tadbirlarida oddiy suhbatlashishni yomon ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Muhim bo'lmagan mavzular haqida suhbatlashish, masalan ob-havo.

cards.ex: Okay, let's get down to brass tacks – what's the budget?
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, asosiy masalaga o'taylik – byudjet qancha?
cards.uzDef: Asosiy masalalarni muhokama qilishni boshlash, batafsil ko'rib chiqish.

cards.ex: The long and short of it is, we can't afford to buy the house.
cards.exUz: Qisqasi, biz uyni sotib olishga qurbimiz yetmaydi.
cards.term: the long and short of it
cards.uzDef: Uzoq hikoyaning qisqa va asosiy mazmuni.

cards.ex: I beg to differ, but I think our strategy is flawed.
cards.exUz: E'tiroz bildirmoqchiman, lekin menimcha bizning strategiyamiz noto'g'ri.
cards.uzDef: Hurmat bilan rozi emasligini bildirish.

cards.ex: They rarely see eye to eye on political issues.
cards.exUz: Ular siyosiy masalalarda kamdan-kam hollarda bir xil fikrda bo'lishadi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha masalalarda kelishuvga erishish, bir xil fikrda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The union and the management are at loggerheads over pay.
cards.exUz: Kasaba uyushmasi va boshqaruv xodimlar maoshi bo'yicha kelishmovchilikda.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy kelishmovchilikda bo'lish, bahslashish.

cards.ex: We're all in the same boat, so let's help each other out.
cards.exUz: Hammamiz bir xil ahvoldamiz, shuning uchun bir-birimizga yordam beraylik.
cards.uzDef: Xuddi shu qiyin vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The news turned my world upside down.
cards.exUz: Bu yangiliklar dunyoni ostin-ustin qilib yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Tartibsiz, chalkash, har narsa teskari.

cards.ex: By and large, people are happy with the new policies.
cards.exUz: Umuman olganda, odamlar yangi siyosatdan mamnun.
cards.uzDef: Umuman olganda, ko'p hollarda, asosan.

cards.ex: I assure you, this business is on the up-and-up.
cards.exUz: Ishonch bilan ayta olamanki, bu biznes halol.
cards.uzDef: Halol, to'g'ri va qonuniy ish qilish.

cards.ex: We need to get approval from the powers that be.
cards.exUz: Biz raxbariyatdan ruxsat olishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori lavozimdagi, qaror qabul qiluvchi odamlar.

cards.ex: Let's call a spade a spade – this project is a failure.
cards.exUz: Haqiqatni aytaylik – bu loyiha muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni ochiqchasiga va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aytish.

cards.ex: In this regard, further research is necessary.
cards.exUz: Shu nuqtai nazardan, qo'shimcha tadqiqotlar zarur.
cards.uzDef: Shu haqida, shu munosabat bilan.

cards.ex: I started the letter with "To whom it may concern."
cards.exUz: Men xatni "Manzillariga" deb boshladim.
cards.uzDef: Kimga tegishli bo'lsa, degan ma'noni anglatadi (rasmiy xatda).

cards.ex: Pursuant to the agreement, we are required to pay royalties.
cards.exUz: Kelishuvga muvofiq, biz royalti to'lashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qonun, qoida yoki shartnomaga muvofiq.

cards.ex: We accepted a payment in lieu of vacation time.
cards.exUz: Biz ta'til o'rniga to'lovni qabul qildik.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsaning o'rniga boshqa narsa.

cards.ex: My assistant is at your disposal to answer any questions.
cards.exUz: Mening yordamchim har qanday savollarga javob berish uchun xizmatingizda.
cards.uzDef: Yordam berishga tayyor, foydalanishingiz mumkin.

cards.ex: I ended the email with "With kind regards."
cards.exUz: Men elektron pochta xatini "Samimiy tilaklar bilan" deb yakunladim.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy xatlarda ishlatiladigan xulosaviy ibora.

cards.ex: As a matter of fact, I've never been to Europe.
cards.exUz: Aslida, men hech qachon Yevropada bo'lmaganman.
cards.uzDef: Gapga urg'u berish yoki kutilmagan ma'lumot qo'shish.

cards.ex: For the record, I disagree with this decision.
cards.exUz: Yozib qo'yish uchun aytaman, men bu qarorga qo'shilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy ravishda qayd etish uchun biror narsani aytish.

cards.ex: The drug is not dangerous per se, but the side effects can be.
cards.exUz: Dori o'zi xavfli emas, lekin yon ta'sirlari xavfli bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'zi, ajratilgan holda.

cards.ex: We conducted due diligence before investing in the company.
cards.exUz: Biz kompaniyaga sarmoya kiritishdan oldin lozim tekshiruv o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy tekshirish va tahlil qilish, ayniqsa biznesda.

cards.ex: I was at a loss for words when I heard the news.
cards.exUz: Men bu xabarni eshitganimda gap topolmay qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Hissiyot yoki hayratdan gapirishga qiynalish.
